livewire.name: Livewire
livewire.desc: Full local Transistor, Quick Feet and Iron Barbs. Volt Absorb is a separate species passive.

kindledfury.name: Kindled Fury
kindledfury.desc: Full local Fluffy and Guts. Flash Fire is a separate species passive.

tidalwave.name: Tidal Wave
tidalwave.desc: Full local Hydration and Rain Dish. Water Absorb is a separate species passive.

permafrost.name: Permafrost
permafrost.desc: Full local Ice Scales and Refrigerate, including their field effects. Ice Body is a separate species passive.

verdantedge.name: Verdant Edge
verdantedge.desc: Full local Sharpness and Grass Pelt, including their field effects. Chlorophyll is a separate species passive.

astralward.name: Astral Ward
astralward.shortDesc: Prevents opposing accuracy drops; ignores opposing evasion boosts.
astralward.desc: Opponents cannot lower its accuracy. Its moves ignore opposing positive evasion stages.

lunarward.name: Lunar Ward
lunarward.desc: Full local Pressure and Illuminate, including field effects. Pressure has its once-per-opponent battle memory. Inner Focus is a separate species passive.

frozenfortress.name: Frozen Fortress
frozenfortress.shortDesc: Ice Body. Physical hits scatter Stealth Rock on the attacker’s side.
frozenfortress.desc: Full local Ice Body heals in hail, snow and icy fields, prevents hail damage and may inflict frostbite on contact attackers. Crumbling Shell sets Stealth Rock after physical hits if that side has none, except on Water Surface, Underwater, Murkwater Surface and Swamp fields. Allied hits place it on the opposing side. No critical-hit immunity.
